meta.name: design-an-interface
meta.description: Generate multiple radically different interface designs for a module using parallel sub-agents. Use when user wants to design an API, explore interface options, compare module shapes, or mentions "design it twice".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用并行子智能体生成多个截然不同的接口设计方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在设计API或模块时探索多种方案并比较
copy.tagline_en: Generate multiple radically different interface designs using parallel sub-agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore and compare multiple interface design options for a module

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会先询问模块需求，然后同时生成 3 个以上截然不同的接口设计方案，并逐一展示、对比优缺点，最后帮你综合出最佳方案。
howto.when: 当你提到“设计接口”、“探索接口选项”、“比较模块形状”或“设计两次”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户认证模块的接口。
say.note: Claude 会先收集需求，然后生成多个方案。

say.text: 我想比较几种不同的 API 设计方案。
say.note: Claude 会并行生成并对比方案。

say.text: 对这个模块做“设计两次”。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first ask about module requirements, then simultaneously generate 3+ radically different interface designs, present each with examples and trade-offs, compare them, and help synthesize the best approach.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "design an interface", "explore interface options", "compare module shapes", or "design it twice".

say_en.text: Design an interface for a user authentication module.
say_en.note: Claude will gather requirements and generate multiple designs.

say_en.text: I want to compare different API design options.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and compare designs in parallel.

say_en.text: Do a 'design it twice' for this module.
